summary: Configured node1 to require passwords of at least 12 characters and three character classes. The policy persisted across a verified node reboot and passed post-restart enforcement tests.
actions_performed: Configured PAM with minlen=12, minclass=3, enforcement enabled for all users including root.
Verified short and insufficient-class passwords are rejected while a compliant generated password is accepted.
Removed temporary verification accounts and credential-bearing files.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified recovery with a changed boot identity.

evidence.summary: PAM/pwquality configuration requires minlen=12 and minclass=3. Live tests before and after reboot independently rejected an 11-character four-class password and a 16-character one-class password, while accepting a generated 16-character four-class password.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 97f57fc4-88d4-4b27-a914-a7aeabacf555; the reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 513a9995-55a5-4245-bc77-8d427109fb59. Package, PAM configuration, checksums, account database, and live policy enforcement recovered successfully.
